world_model_delta: Ritual durations: ELEMENTAL_CYCLE (instantaneous), RESOURCE_FESTIVAL (3 turns), FACTION_CONCLAVE (1 turn), BRIDGE_CEREMONY (5 turns). Rituals may not be interrupted once started. Duration countdown begins at turn-start the ritual is initiated.
validator_question: Can rituals be prematurely ended by faction action?
risk_of_symbol_smuggling: LOW — non-interruptible by design; deterministic countdown
